author: Brent Thompson <brent.thompson@ucf.edu>
scope: Specifications of information representations and their source-reviewed transformations. These are not domain entities or claims that an execution occurred.

states.label: Selected papers
states.description: A ranked corpus with source identities and available PDFs.
states.note: Dashboard ingestion saves this separately. CLI extraction records selection in run.json.

states.label: Text and captions
states.description: Cleaned sections, caption records and temporary extraction windows.
states.note: Windows are temporary model inputs, not separate paper ontologies. Saved parsed files are wrapper-specific.

states.label: Paper concepts and claims
states.description: One reconciled record per paper; concept IDs are local to that paper.
states.note: c1 in one paper does not identify c1 in another. Quote verification measures text overlap, not entailment.

states.label: Canonical vocabulary
states.description: Cross-paper concepts with aliases, supporting papers and remapped claims.
states.note: Exact original concept-ID merge decisions are currently transient. Supporting papers and aliases cannot recover every merge.

states.label: Placed ontology classes
states.description: Canonical records acquire parent decisions and stable domain IRIs.
states.note: A BFO/CCO-connected hierarchy does not establish that every parent decision is scientifically correct.

states.label: Definitions and restrictions
states.description: Live classes gain definitions, supported restrictions and external candidates.
states.note: Candidates are not committed mappings. Generated, draft and supported definitions have different authority.

states.label: Formal domain ontology
states.description: OWL classes, hierarchy, restrictions and committed external mappings.
states.note: Interoperability can update in-memory definitions and facets without rewriting enriched.json; inspect its sidecars.

states.label: Cross-domain ontology
states.description: Selected domain graphs are imported and united, with reviewed cross-domain links.
states.note: The merged formal graph preserves source ontologies. Bridge groups summarize connections; they are not necessarily new OWL classes.

states.label: Reports and figures
states.description: Readable summaries and plots assembled from selected saved results.
states.note: Reports can be generated for a single domain without integration. Report availability is distinct from recorded completion.

states.label: Literature-claims layer
states.description: Evidence-bearing scientific claims remain separate from formal OWL assertions.
states.note: This layer is not automatically unioned into the integration's merged formal ontology. Keep source domain layers accessible.

transformations.label: Extract text and retain captions
omits: page geometry is not retained as exact evidence bounds
transformations.limitation: A text window is not a separately saved micro-ontology.

transformations.label: Extract and reconcile within each paper
preserves: retained evidence quotes and figure references
omits: failed or unresolved model outputs may not become usable claims
transformations.limitation: Verified quote overlap is not scientific entailment. Saved measurement concept identifies its property concept.

transformations.label: Merge aliases and remap claims
omits: exact paper-local concept-ID → canonical-ID merge map is not persisted
aggregation retains limited evidence, not necessarily every quote
transformations.limitation: The current saved runs support reconstructed candidate links, not a complete recorded merge history.

transformations.label: Assign parents and domain IRIs
preserves: canonical concept IDs and supporting-paper fields
omits: excluded records are retained but do not become live classes
transformations.limitation: Fallback parents and unresolved placement flags require review.

transformations.label: Enrich classes from claims and ontology sources
omits: unsupported or incompatible restriction candidates are rejected
transformations.limitation: The agent returns (classes, properties); generated text and external candidates remain reviewable.

transformations.label: Commit mappings and export formal OWL
omits: not every extracted scientific claim is asserted as an OWL axiom
transformations.limitation: Mapping and definition sidecars record later in-memory changes; enriched.json is not a complete final export record.

transformations.label: Preserve the literature claims separately
adds: a separate evidence-bearing RDF claims layer
omits: this layer is not automatically included in the merged formal integration
transformations.limitation: Claims remain reported literature assertions; they do not acquire scientific validity through RDF export.

transformations.label: Connect selected domain ontologies
preserves: full selected source formal graphs in merged output
omits: review caps leave some candidates unreviewed
transformations.limitation: A class can be in the merged ontology without receiving a cross-domain mapping.

transformations.label: Summarize results and review findings
omits: individual plots can fail or be skipped
transformations.limitation: Reports summarize selected results; they do not replace source evidence or establish complete figure coverage.
